csv_project_name: A/E service for Hurricane Safe Room
csv_scope_of_work: City of Orange Beach Alabama seeks the services of a professional architectural firm which has the knowledge, experience, and expertise to perform the services as requested. The project involves construction of a stand-alone, site built, dual-purpose, FEMA 361 and ICC500 200 MPH rated 1st Responder Hurricane safe room in Orange Beach, Alabama. The site built 1st responder hurricane safe room will be designed and constructed to meet the latest version of FEMA Publication 361 and ICC-500 hurricane safe room criteria and will be able to withstand 200 mph winds. The City of Orange Beach requires design work experience based on FEMA 361 and ICC-500. Significant additional consideration will be given to firms with design experience related to FEMA safe room projects.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
